summary: P0 Kalan Testing - Code Review Complete. Database is in DEGRADED state (PostgreSQL connection refused). Functional endpoint testing blocked by DB unavailability. Code review confirms all requested features are properly implemented with correct response shapes.

critical.impact: All API endpoints return 503 Service Unavailable

GET /api/admin/identity/users/deleted-li.notes: Filters only users with deleted_at set. Uses hard_delete_candidate_snapshot for retention_days_remaining and risk_score calculation.

POST /api/admin/identity/users/bulk-stat.notes: Policy-aware preview with risk scoring. Checks super_admin_protected, hard_deleted_user_cannot_be_restored, kill_switch_active blockers.

POST /api/admin/identity/users/{id}/reac.notes: Always returns approval_required. Uses _request_if_critical with action_key='restore_user'. Creates audit log for IDENTITY_USER_RESTORE_REQUESTED.

response_shape.risk_score: integer (30 if eligible, else min(100, 60 + blockers*10))

hard_delete_candidate_snapshot.notes: Validates hard delete guards: self_hard_delete_forbidden, super_admin_hard_delete_forbidden, hard_delete_requires_soft_deleted, hard_delete_retention_not_completed (90 days), hard_delete_blocked_by_pending_approvals, hard_delete_blocked_by_active_sessions, hard_delete_blocked_by_open_execution, hard_delete_blocked_by_exchange_dependency, hard_delete_blocked_by_risk_policy_dependency, hard_delete_blocked_by_scope_dependency.

_apply_approval_action hard_delete_user.notes: Validates hard delete guard, purges FK dependencies via _purge_user_fk_dependencies, creates IDENTITY_USER_HARD_DELETE_FINALIZED audit log with purge_counts, then deletes user from DB.

bulk_preview_panel.notes: Displays risk_badge, risk_score, eligible, blockers for each user in preview.

deleted_lifecycle_panel.notes: Displays retention_days_remaining and risk_score for each deleted user.

approval_impact_summary.notes: Calculates normalized risk score based on action weights (hard_delete=95, soft_delete=85, grant_privileged_role=90, etc.)
